newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Jiang Zemin vows to pursue Deng's reforms.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiang Zemin vows to pursue Deng's reforms.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin vowed on Tuesday in his eulogy to paramount leader Deng Xiaoping to push ahead with his market-oriented reforms and opening to the outside world that have transformed a nation.

"The decision to take economic construction as the centre represents the most fundamental achievement made under Comrade Deng Xiaoping's leadership in the effort to bring order out of chaos," Jiang said in his funeral eulogy in the Great Hall of the People.
"All our work must be subordinate to and serve this centre," he said. "Development is the most essential criterion."
Describing reform as inevitable for China's modernisation, Jiang pledged to follow Deng's master plan for reform, while adhering to socialist rule.
"We must carry on the reform of the economic structure in depth," he said, vowing to press ahead with both political and economic change.
